The National announced roster moves, notable on Gray:

They selected the contracts of RHP Jarlin Susana, RHP Travis Sykora and RHP Alejandro Rosario. 

The Nationals also designated RHP Josiah Gray, RHP Braxton Roxby, RHP Gus Varland and LHP Carson Palmquist for assignment.
We've claimed LHP Philip Abner off waivers from the Baltimore Orioles.
